# Breeze

> > Breeze is an all-in-one self-care toolkit offering science-based mental health assessments, mood tracking, and evidence-backed wellness resources for personal growth and emotional well-being.

Breeze provides a comprehensive platform of diagnostic self-assessment tools, expert-reviewed educational content, and business wellness solutions. The platform specializes in mental health screening across conditions like ADHD, anxiety, OCD, trauma, and personality disorders, combined with personality and emotional intelligence assessments to help users achieve self-discovery and mental wellness.

## Key Topics

- Mental Health Assessment
- Self-Discovery
- ADHD Screening
- Anxiety Disorder
- Emotional Intelligence
- Personality Types
- Trauma & ACE Test
- Borderline Personality Disorder
- Self-Awareness

- Employee Wellness

- Mental Wellness

## Core Platform

- [Breeze: Mental Health App That Unlocks Your Inner Power](https://breeze-wellbeing.com): Homepage for Breeze all-in-one self-care toolkit with mood tracking and mental health tests
- [About - Breeze](https://breeze-wellbeing.com/about): Company mission, values, and product roadmap for Breeze self-care toolkit
- [Tests - Breeze](https://breeze-wellbeing.com/tests): Directory of comprehensive mental health assessments and psychological evaluation tools

## Mental Health & Condition Assessments

- [Do I have ADHD? Take the ADHD quiz from Breeze](https://breeze-wellbeing.com/adhd-test): ASRS-based ADHD screening test for adult symptom assessment and self-diagnosis
- [Anxiety Disorder Test: Check If You Have Anxiety With Breeze Quiz](https://breeze-wellbeing.com/anxiety-test): GAD-7 based anxiety screening tool for generalized anxiety disorder assessment
- [Free OCD Test – Check Your Symptoms Online | Breeze Wellbeing](https://breeze-wellbeing.com/ocd-test): Science-based OCD symptom screening for obsessive-compulsive disorder assessment
- [BPD Test – Borderline Personality Disorder Self-Assessment from Breeze](https://breeze-wellbeing.com/borderline-personality-disorder): BPD symptom screening tool based on DSM-5 diagnostic criteria
- [Childhood Trauma Test (ACES Test) – Discover the Impact & Begin Healing](https://breeze-wellbeing.com/childhood/start): ACE test for adverse childhood experiences assessment and trauma healing resources
- [Neurodivergent Test: Check If You're Neurodivergent With Breeze Quiz](https://breeze-wellbeing.com/neurodivergent-test): Neurodiversity screening for ADHD and autism spectrum traits in adults

## Personality & Relationship Assessments

- [Emotional Intelligence Test Online - EQ test | Breeze](https://breeze-wellbeing.com/emotional-intelligence-test): EQ assessment tool measuring self-awareness, empathy, and interpersonal skills
- [Personality Type Test – Discover Your True Self | Breeze](https://breeze-wellbeing.com/personality-type): MBTI-based personality type assessment revealing strengths and self-awareness
- [Attachment Style Quiz: Take the Attachment Style Test at Breeze](https://breeze-wellbeing.com/attachment-style-test): Attachment theory-based quiz revealing relationship patterns and emotional dynamics
- [Narcissist Test — Is My Partner a Narcissist? Take the Test Now At Breeze](https://breeze-wellbeing.com/narcissist-test): Relationship assessment tool identifying narcissistic traits and red flags
- [Anger Management Test: Take the Test Now At Breeze](https://breeze-wellbeing.com/anger-test): Anger issues self-assessment using Multidimensional Anger Scale for emotional control

## Wellness & Well-Being Assessments

- [Well-Being Test Breeze: Your Key Wellbeing Assessment](https://breeze-wellbeing.com/wellbeing-test): Mental wellness profile assessment evaluating emotional resilience and wellbeing
- [Likeable Person Test: Am I a Likeable Person? | Breeze Wellbeing](https://breeze-wellbeing.com/likable-person-test): Likability assessment with growth plan for improving social presence and communication
- [Toxic Personality Test: Check If You're a Toxic Person With Breeze Quiz](https://breeze-wellbeing.com/toxic-traits-personality-test): Self-assessment of toxic personality traits and behavioral patterns

## Enterprise Solutions

- [For Business - Breeze](https://breeze-wellbeing.com/for-business): Breeze for Business: employee wellness platform with CBT and burnout reduction
